description: Stop a batch. A URL already being read finishes and is charged, because it is a page we are already paying for. Every URL not yet started becomes `skipped`, which costs nothing and is not a verdict about the URL: submit those positions again whenever you like. Safe to repeat; a batch that has already ended answers with how it ended.

id.description: The batch's id, as create returned it.

name: cancel_batch
title: Cancel a batch
